_doc: A2 limits: none. Every cell of tests/visual/icon-a2.sh meets its floor (owner decision 2026-11-08, R7-REQ-13: icon modes at 3:1 before 1.0). Key: the rule (E outside, S separation) and the label of the A2 line (icon, mode, size, appearance, scenario, tint, transparency); value: the measured metric of the rule, default: the Default rendering's. tests/shell/a2_limits_doc.sh keeps docs/specs/ui.md and this table in agreement and fails while the table holds a row.
